मकान वकरार्ा भत्ता ( HRA): मकान र्कराया भत्ता भारत सरकार/भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण ( ZSI) क े  
लार्ू र्नयमों क े  अनुसार प्रदान र्कया जाएर्ा। र्कसी भी प्तस्थर्त में यह संबंर्ित क्षेत्र में क ें द्र सरकार क े  
कमगचाररयों को देय दरों से अर्िक नहीं होर्ा। HRA की र्णना का आ िार संबंर्ित ररसचग ि े लो को 
वास्तव में देय वजीिा (Stipend) होर्ा। 
प्रगवत ररप रा: पररयोजना ि े लो अपने कायग की प्रर्र्त क े  संबंि में र्निागररत प्रारूप में मार्सक एवं वार्र्गक 
ररपोटग, प्रिान अन्वेर्क (Principal Investigator-PI) क े  माध्यम से प्रस्तुत करेंर्े। 
ि े लोर्शप की अवर्ि समाि होने पर पररयोजना ि े लो को संपूणग कायगकाल क े  दौरान र्कए र्ए कायग की 
र्वस्तृत ररपोटग , प्रकार्शत शोि कायों/पांिुर्लर्पयों तथा पुनमुगर्द्रत प्रर्तयों ( Reprints) सर्हत, प्रिान 
अन्वेर्क क े  माध्यम से भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक को प्रस्तुत करनी होर्ी। 
शोि कायग क े  पररणामों को समकक्ष-समीर्क्षत ( Peer-reviewed) शोि पर्त्रकाओं तथा वैज्ञार्नक 
जानकारी क े  अन्य लोकर्प्रय माध्यमों में प्रकार्शत करने क े  र्लए प्रोत्सार्हत र्कया जाएर्ा। इस संबंि में 
अंर्तम र्नणगय भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण (ZSI) क े  र्नदेशक क े  र्ववेकार्िकार क े  अिीन होर्ा। 
शोि पत्रों में योर्दान देने वाले सभी शोिकतागओं एवं अन्य टीम सदस्ों को उनक े  योर्दान क े  अनुरूप 
उर्चत लेिकीय स्थान (Authorship) प्रदान र्कया जाएर्ा। लेिकीय अर्िकार को लेकर र्कसी र्ववाद 
की प्तस्थर्त में ZSI क े  र्नदेशक सौहादगपूणग तरीक े  से उसका समािान करेंर्े। 
ZSI में र्कए र्ए अनुसंिान से प्राि सभी प्रकाशनों में संबंर्ित र्वत्तपोर्ण एजेंर्सयों को उर्चत आभार एवं 
श्रेय (Acknowledgement) र्दया जाएर्ा। 
हालाँर्क, अनुसंिान से प्राि पररणामों क े  व्ावसार्यक उपयोर् तथा उससे संबंर्ित पेटेंट क े  अर्िकार 
पूणगतः  भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण (ZSI) क े  पास सुरर्क्षत रहेंर्े। 
यर्द कोई पररयोजना ि े लो र्निागररत कायगकाल की समाप्ति से पहले ि े लोर्शप छोडना चाहता/चाहती है, 
तो इसक े  र्लए भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक की पूवग अनुमर्त प्राि करना अर्नवायग होर्ा। 
यर्द भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक र्कसी ि े लो क े  कायग की प्रर्र्त अथवा उसक े  आचरण से संतुष्ट 
नहीं होते हैं, तो ि े लोर्शप समाि की जा सकती है। 
चयन प्रर्िया, िनरार्श क े  भुर्तान, आकप्तिक अनुदान (Contingent Grant) क े  उपयोर्, प्रर्र्त ररपोटग 
प्रस्तुत करने, कायगकाल, शोि प्रकाशनों, पेटेंट तथा अस्थायी अथवा सवेतन अवकाश , व्ाख्यान कायग, 
अनुसंिान, नौकरी आर्द से संबंर्ित मामलों में पयागवरण, वन एवं जलवायु पररवतगन मंत्रालय (MoEFCC) 
क े  र्नयमों क े  अनुसार SPA एवं PA पदों पर लार्ू सामान्य र्नयम प्रभावी होंर्े। 
 
भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक आवश्यकता पडने पर मुख्यालय से अर्िकाररयों को उन क्षेत्रीय क ें द्रों 
में भेज सकते हैं, जहाँ ि े लो एवं एसोर्सएट कायगरत हैं। इन अर्िकाररयों द्वारा कायग की समीक्षा, लेिा-
जोिा, उपप्तस्थर्त तथा अन्य संबंर्ित अर्भलेिों का र्नरीक्षण र्कया जा सकता है। 
ि े लोर्शप की अवर्ि क े  दौरान र्कसी भी प्रकार का सवेतन अथवा मानद, अंशकार्लक अथवा 
पूणगकार्लक रोजर्ार या र्नजी व्वसाय/प्रैप्तक्टस, चाहे वह मानद आिार पर ही क्ों न हो, अनुमत नहीं 
होर्ा। 
ररसचग ि े लो को देय वजीिा आयकर अर्िर्नयम की िारा 10(16) क े  अंतर्गत आयकर से मुक्त होर्ा।

To perform all project-related work, including the preparation and storage of 
project data, and the work assigned by the Project Investigators. 
 
Candidates should be proficient in laboratory techniques of cytology and 
histopathology, and Proficiency in computer data entry is desirable. 
 
The selected candidates will perform all work of the project, including the 
preparation and storage of its data, and work assigned by the Principal/Co-
Investigators. In particular, they will: 
• Perform sample collection and transport from the Gynaecology 
department in the hospital to the Department of Pathology in the 
academic block 
• Receive, register, label, and Track project samples and histology 
specimens, and keep the sample records; 
• Prepare liquid-based cytology slides and histopathology sections, 
carry out Papanicolaou and haematoxylin and eosin staining, and 
carry out immunocytochemistry and immunohistochemistry for p16 
and Ki-67 as the project protocol requires; 
• Operate and care for the project equipment, namely the liquid-based 
cytology processor, the slide stainer and the antigen retrieval system, 
and keep their logs; 
• Keep the stock and inventory of consumables and the laboratory 
registers; 
• Prepare, enter and check project data in the prescribed formats, store 
the data and its backups on the project’s secured storage, and maintain

items.doc_text: Before you apply Candidate Instructions General guidelines for applying to BSF recruitment posts. Always cross-check post-specific eligibility in the relevant advertisement before applying. Standard guidance — refer to the specific recruitment advertisement (PDF) for authoritative details. 01 Check Eligibility Confirm the age limit for the post you are applying to, including any category-based age relaxation (SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Servicemen). Verify the minimum educational qualification specified in the recruitment advertisement. Check domicile requirements for the specific state quota you intend to apply under. 02 Register & Apply Online Create your profile and verify your mobile number/email via OTP before proceeding. Once submitted, the application form cannot be edited — review every section carefully before final submission. Photograph and signature uploads must meet the specified format, dimensions and file-size limits. 03 Application Fee Fee can be paid online via net banking, debit/credit card or UPI through the candidate dashboard. SC/ST candidates, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempted from the application fee as per government norms. Retain the payment receipt/transaction ID until your application process concludes. 04 Physical Standard & Efficiency Test Physical Standard Test (PST) measures height, chest (where applicable) and weight against post-specific criteria. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) consists of timed events — race, long jump, high jump as notified for the post. Carry a valid original photo ID proof and the admit card to the PST/PET venue; no candidate is permitted entry without both. 05 Written Exam & Medical Examination The Computer Based Test (CBT) covers General Knowledge, Reasoning, Numerical Aptitude and General English/Hindi. Candidates qualifying the CBT are called for a detailed medical examination at a designated government hospital. Temporary medical unfitness may be given a review medical examination as per applicable rules. 06 Document Verification & Final Merit All original certificates (educational, category, domicile, NCC/sports where claimed) are verified in person. Discrepancy between uploaded documents and originals can lead to disqualification at any stage. The final merit list is published on this portal along with the category-wise cut-off. Ready to apply? items.doc_text: User Engagement Programs User Engagement Program in role-based learning is an initiative that allows participants to learn and understand cyber hygiene practices in simulated cyber scenarios. This program is designed to interact and actively involve users in a learning program and to instil cyber hygiene practices in a way that's simple, steady, and easy to understand. As we navigate our digital world, it's important to stay safe and secure. To make your learning journey exciting, flexible and rewarding it includes various activities like quizzes, competitions, game-based learning, activities, exercises, case studies, Awards and reward points etc. specifically tailored for different roles to boost engagement and make learning more effective. The program is packed with interactive materials, real-world applications, and supportive community. The following are some of the user engagement programs proposed National level competitions - painting, drawing, poster making, sketching, etc. Regional level - thematic quizzes, etc. National level Quizzes, etc. Cyber Clubs @ Schools Handbooks (Multi-lingual Awareness Handbooks ) Quizzes Cyber hygiene quizzes are the evaluation tools used to measure a person's self knowledge or understanding of the learning program. It's about learning the best practices to protect their digital environment . Our learning program will conduct both Regional and National Level Quizzes, a chance to showcase your knowledge, challenging yourself and learning the best practices to protect their digital environment. Competitions Our learning program will host National Level Competitions. This includes a range of exciting contests such as Drawing and painting, Slogan Writing, Reels, Cartoon story boards, Real time incidents, poster presentations and Short Video Competitions. It's a golden opportunity for all of you to showcase your creativity, voice your thoughts, and stand a chance to shine on a national platform. These clubs will offer a unique platform to interact, learn, and grow together in the dynamic field of technology. They are designed to foster collaboration, enhance knowledge, and promote practical applications. Awards The implementation of recognition pathways such as awards and accolades, recognizing individual and school achievements at various levels. CSIR-CENTRE FOR CELLULAR AND MOLECULAR BIOLOGY 
Uppal Road, Habsiguda, 
Hyderabd 500 007 Telangana 
 
Notification Number: 2026/02                         Date: 11.11.2026 
: 
 
 
 
 
NOTICE INVITING APPLICATIONS FOR EMPANELMENT OF 
CANDIDATES AS PROJECT STAFF PURELY ON TEMPORARY BASIS  
The CSIR -CCMB, Hyderabad,  invites a pplications from eligible 
candidates for empanelment as project staff in broad research areas 
of Cell/ Molecular biology/ Structural biology/ Ecology & evolutionary 
biology as below: 
 
Essential qualification & Experience 
Upper Age limit: 35 years 
i) Masters/ Integrated Masters  Degree in Natural or 
Agricultural or Pharmaceutical  Sciences OR bachelor’s 
degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a 
recognized University or equivalent. 
WITH/ WITHOUT Desirable number of years of experience 
in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic 
Institutions or science and Technology Organizations and 
Scientific activities and services. 
 
Upper Age limit: 40 years 
ii) Doctoral Degree in Science/ Pharma/ MD/ MS OR Masters/ 
Integrated Masters degree in Engineering or Technology from 
a recognized University or equivalent. 
        WITH/ WITHOUT Desirable number of years of experience    
        in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic           
        Institutions or science and Technology Organizations and  
        Scientific activities and services.  
 
 
 
 
CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology, Hyderabad (CSIR -CCMB) is a premier 
Research Institute under the aegis of Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), 
an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. 
It is a leading research organization in frontier areas of modern biology and invo lved in 
conducting high quality basic research and training in multidisciplinary areas of modern 
biology and to seeking potential applications of the work. 
 
General terms and conditions: 
 
1 How to apply Candidates who fulfill the qualifications and 
experience are required to fill up the ONLINE 
APPLICATION format by clicking on the following 
link……..  
 
The name of the candidate in the application form must 
be the same as mentioned in the certificate of class X. 
In case the candidate has changed his name 
subsequent to Class X, t he evidence to that effect 
should be furnished at the time of interview. 
 
Candidates with last semester result awaited or 
incomplete degrees are not eligible to apply. 
 
For any technical problem while submitting the online 
application, candidates may write to psr@ccmb.res.in  
 
Last date to submit application through online: 02nd 
December 2026. 
 
2 Empanelment Empanelment means the shortlisted candidates will be 
in the panel of CSIR -CCMB for six months from the 
date of result . This notification is for creation of a 
panel.  The panel shall be in alphabetical order and not 
to be construed as order of merit .  The selection for 
empanelment does not confer any right to candidate to 
claim for engagement as pr oject staff / regular staff . 
Candidates may be called only as per requirement of 
CSIR-CCMB, Hyderabad. 
 
3 Mode of 
empanelment 
This involves two stages: 
i) Screening of applications by a committee 
duly constituted by the competent authority 
for shortlisting eligible candidates.  
ii) Interview (Online/offline) of the shortlisted 
candidates by a selection committee duly 
constituted by the competent authority  for 
Empanelment. 
 
The date, time and venue of the interview will be 
notified in due course through email only. 
 
4 Engagement  The engagement of empanelled candidates purely on 
temporary basis with the approval of Competent 
Authority shall be based on requirement in the projects 
and availability of funds. The tenure may be extended 
or curtailed based on the conduct and the performance 
of the incumbent as well as requirement of the 
institute. However, the engagement shall be co -
 
terminus with the duration of the project or decision of 
the competent authority, whichever is earlier.  
The engagement of project staff in different projects 
either in same Lab/Instt. or different Lab./Instt. of 
CSIR taken together shall not exceed 5 years in any 
case. 
 
5 Payment On engagement as project staff, payment of 
emoluments shall be as per CSIR guidelines  or 
applicable funding agency guidelines issued from time 
to time with the approval of the Competent authority. 
 
6 Age  Relaxation in the age limit for the candidates belonging 
to the cat egory of SC/ST/PwBD/Women and the 
category of OBC shall be 05 years and 03 years 
respectively or as per Govt. of India instructions issued 
in this regard from time to time.  Age will be calculated 
as on the last date of receipt of online applications. 
(Age will be calculated as on the last date of receipt of 
online applications.) 
 
7 Experience The period of experience in a discipline / area of work 
shall be counted after the date of acquiring the said 
educational qualifications. 
 
8 Leave The incumbent would not be entitled to any kind of 
regular leave. However, they would be allowed for one-
day Leave for each completed month  in the event of 
their engagement as project staff. 
 
9 TA/DA No TA/ DA admissible for attending test/interview, 
joining the position. 
 
10 Office timings/ 
Working hours 
The incumbent is required to perform the assigned 
duties during working hours i.e. from 9:30 AM to 6:00 
PM on working days. The incumbent will not be allowed 
to take up any other assignment during the period of 
engagement. He /She may be required to work on 
Saturday/Sunday/other Gazetted holidays and 
beyond working hours also if need be. 
 
11 Tax deduction 
at source 
The Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted, 
as per the prevailing rules will be deducted at source 
before effecting the payment.  
12 Confidentiality 
of data and 
documents 
The Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) of the data 
collected as well as t he deliverables produced for the 
office shall remain with this office. No one shall utilize 
or publish or disclose or part with, to a third party, any 
part of the data or statistics or proceedings or 
information collected for the purpose of this 
assignment or during the course of assignment for the 
 
office, without the express written consent of the office. 
The incumbent shall be bound to hand over the entire 
set of records of assignment to the Office before the 
expiry of the contract, and before the final p ayment is 
released by the office. 
 
13 Termination of 
Service 
The performance of project personnel would be 
reviewed periodically so that candidates not found up 
to the mark, could be terminated. The engagement may 
be terminated at any time by the office w ithout 
assigning any reasons by giving a one month notice. In 
case, the person desires to leave the assignment, 
he/she may also do so by giving one month notice or 
payment of one month stipend in lieu of, which can be 
condoned/ curtailed/ extended dependin g upon the 
discretion of the Competent Authority. 
 
14 DISCLAIMER Candidates who are applying for any of the above areas 
shall ensure that they fulfill the essential 
qualifications. In case they are found not fulfilling the 
essential criteria or that they have provided misleading 
information, then their candidature for the post may 
be rejected at any stage of empanelment or after 
selection by the competent authority. 
 
15 Disqualification Canvassing in any form and / or bringing any influence 
political or otherwise will be treated as a 
disqualification for the post. 
 
    
 
Controller of Administration
